summary: Node.js 22.23.4, 24.22.1, and 26.12.1 fix the 21 October 2026 security release. The high issue on every line includes a Brotli decoder bug in the fetch path.
remediation: Run Vigil on Node 22.23.4 or newer on the 22 line, 24.22.1 or newer on the 24 line, or 26.12.1 or newer on the 26 line.
knownExploited: CISA added CVE-2026-111497 (Google Brotli) to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 27 October 2026 (catalog 2026.10.27, due 10 November 2026). Node's 21 October 2026 security releases are the project's fix for that bug on the 22, 24, and 26 lines. Ransomware use is listed as unknown. Forensic triage is listed as not required. This finding is still only a comparison of the local Node version.
kevAction: CISA's 27 October 2026 alert says to apply the vendor fix. Use a Node build from the 21 October 2026 security releases or newer on that line.
